🌿 Environment — Key Points
• Environment = air, water, land + living beings and how they interact.
• Ecosystem = living (biotic) + non-living (abiotic) parts working together.
• Food chain: producer → primary consumer → secondary consumer → tertiary consumer.
• Biodiversity = variety of life: genetic, species and ecosystem diversity.
• Sustainable development = meeting today's needs without harming future generations' ability to meet theirs.

🌍 Ecosystem — Key Points
• Producers (green plants) make food using sunlight — photosynthesis.
• Consumers depend on producers directly or indirectly.
• Decomposers (bacteria, fungi) break down dead matter and recycle nutrients.
• Energy flows one way through an ecosystem; nutrients cycle.
• A food web is many linked food chains in one habitat.

📚 English Literature — Key Points
• Jane Austen (1775–1817): Pride and Prejudice, Sense and Sensibility, Emma.
• T.S. Eliot (1888–1965): The Waste Land, modernist poetry, Nobel Prize 1948.
• John Keats (1795–1821): Romantic poet — the great odes, including Ode to a Nightingale.
• Tip: for exams, pair each author with one famous work + one fact (period, movement, prize).
